{"reason": "Failure rows are demand-forecast-error labeled unknown: bias-amount 0.065–0.081 fell under the 0.1 threshold, and several rows have market-mismatch=#t with forecast-bias=#f. I added market-signal-mismatch? as an alternative demand-forecast-error signal and lowered the bias threshold to 0.06. Supplier-delay is still checked first, so accuracy and recovered amount should not fall.", "source": "(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((or (and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
              (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.06))
         (market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
